This land na my own, God don bless me with am. I dey plant yam with small maize and vegetable for between, because na so we dey do am here for many years. My money no plenty, so I go use wetin I fit afford and use my hand well well. My children go help me, but for making mound and harvest, I go call people come help me and pay dem.

For fertilizer, the government one no dey reach us well, but I go try buy one or two bag NPK if price no too high — small small for the yam. I still dey use the droppings from my goat and cow, and I go burn the bush and put ash for the mound. I no get water pump, na rain I dey wait for. The seed yam, na from last year harvest I keep. For the weeds, bush too much, so I go buy small herbicide to spray, e dey save my back.
